definitions.short: a burden ; specifically, tribute , or (abstractly) porterage ; figuratively, an utterance , chiefly a doom , especially singing ; mental, desire
definitions.usage: burden, carry away, prophecy, × they set, song, tribute.
definitions.full: H4853. massa ' II. מַשָּׂא noun masculine Psa 38:5 load, burden, lifting, bearing, tribute ; — ׳מ absolute Neh 13:19 +; construct 2Kin 5:17 +; suffix מַשָּׂאוֺ Exod 23:5 2 t.; מַשַּׂאֲכֶם Deut 1:12 ; מַשָּׂאָם Num 4:27 2 t.; — 1 load, burden of ass Exod 23:5 (E), mules 2Kin 5:17 , camels 8:9 , compare Isa 46:1-2 , hanging on a peg 22:25 (figurative); forbidden on Sabbath Jer 17:21-22 , 24 , 27 ; Neh 13:15 , 19 ; figurative of people as burden Num 11:11 , 17 (JE), Deut 1:12 , compare לְמ ׳הָיָה עַלֿ 2Sam 15:33 ; 19:36 ( אֶלֿ ), also לְמַשָּׂא עָלַי וָאֶהְיֶה Job 7:20 ; of iniquities Psa 38:5 . — Hosea 8:10 read מְשֹׁחַ , so ᵐ5 We Now GASm. 2 verbal noun, lifting, uplifting , only ׳מ נַפְשָׁם Ezek 24:25 the uplifting of their soul , i.e. that to which they lift up their soul, their heart's desire. 3 verbal noun, bearing, carrying , Num 4:24 (+ לַעֲבֹד ), 2Chr 20:25 ; 35:3 ( בַּכָּתֵף ), so probably 1Chr 15:22 (twice in verse); 15:27 (compare Be Kau; > singing, uplifting of voice , e.g. Öttli); especially of responsibility and duty of bearing sacred vessels (often || מְּקֻדָּה עֲבֹדָה, ) Num 4:15 , 19 , 27 (twice in verse); 4:49 , מ ׳עֲבֹדַת 4:47 , מ ׳מִשְׁמֶרֶת 4:31 ; 4:32 . 4 perhaps what is carried, brought , i.e. tribute מ ׳כֶּסֶף 2Chr 17:11 silver as tribute (+ מִנְחָה ; compare נשׂא Qal ; others, silver by the load i.e. in great quantity). — I. מַשָּׂא see above. III. מַשָּׂא noun masculine Isa 14:28 utterance, oracle (compare נשׂא 1b (6); Gf Jer 23:33 ); — ׳מ absolute Isa 14:28 +; usually construct 13:1 +; — of prophetic utterance: 2Kin 9:25 ; Isa 14:28 ; Ezek 12:10 ; 2Chr 24:27 (with עַל ); ׳מ בָבֶל Isa 13:1 , ׳מ מוֺאָב 15:1 , compare 17:1 ; 19:1 ; 21:1 , 11 ; 22:1 ; 23:1 ; 30:6 ; Nahum 1:1 ; ׳מ בערב Isa 21:13 is later insert (Di); ׳מ = revelation , ׳הַמּ הַנָּבִיא חֲבַקּוּק חָזָה אֲשֶׁר Hab 1:1 ; ׳מ ׳י utterance of ׳י Jer 23:33-34 , 36 , 38 (3 t. in verse) (compare 2Kin 9:25 ), see also 9:33 b (read הַמַּשָּׂא אַתֶּם ), with word-play, — followed by וְנָטַשְׁתִּי 9:36 b; ׳מ י ׳דְבַר Zech 9:1 (+ בארץ ), 12:1 (+ עַליִֿשְׂרָאֵל ), Mal 1:1 (+ ׳אֶליִֿשׂ ). — Prov 31:1 see I. מַשָּׂא , p. 601 above; in 30:1 read מִמַּשָּׂא from Massa (Mühlau, De), or הַמַּשָּׂאִי (Wild), which however is perhaps not original, but borrowed from 31:1 (compare Wild on the passage Frankenb Spr. p. 5 ; corrupt name of Agur's home or tribe, Kau).
